indices.name: S&P 500
indices.note: Second straight drop as tech dragged; the index ended October down about 1.2%.

indices.name: Nasdaq
indices.note: Hit hardest as Intel, Reddit and Alphabet sold off; down about 5% for October, its worst month since March 2025.

indices.name: Dow
indices.note: Fell less than the others and still finished October up about 1.5%.

notes: Intel plunged about 29%, its worst day since 1974, after a weak holiday-quarter forecast. Together with Amazon's and Alphabet's results, it deepened doubts that heavy AI spending will pay off soon.
Reddit also fell about 29% on a softer outlook and Roblox dropped sharply, while Regeneron jumped about 13% and Exxon and Chevron briefly touched record highs.
Oil rose on renewed US–Iran tension, with WTI near $104, and talk of a possible Fed rate hike in December added pressure.
events: Tue 3 Nov: US midterm elections. Markets are watching for any renewed US strikes on Iran afterwards.
Fed officials are signalling a possible rate hike; the next decision is in December.
